scope: Historical PR626 CK frame-zero compensation: bound the complete separately lowered target-forest cost when each nonroot may use any signed power of two as parent coefficient. Certify finite root-dominance inequalities, the infinite exponent tails and an exact signed-unit forest witness.
seed_diversification: 36 mod 3 selects CK from CK/JP8/X4; seed fixes any deterministic inspection ordering, with complete class coverage independent of it.
optimistic_pricing: Both basis shears cost 2*(4+abs(e)) per real component; residual row costs use the unchanged Horner bill. The complete +/-1/4, +/-1/2, +/-1, +/-2, +/-4 screen has no nonunit edge cheaper than the child root and gives the existing 16,364 forest floor. Investigate the all-exponent closure rather than continuing construction search.
method: Every 112*111 ordered parent/child pair, both signs, exponents -3 through 3; quarter-grid coefficient tail proof for all |e|>=3; edge deletion reduces nonunit forests to unit forests; independent MST/cycle certificate and arbitrary-dirt panel replay.
stopping_rule: Complete the declared finite core and analytic tail obligations once. No stochastic restarts or parameter-budget extension.
expected_deliverable: Scoped negative result and exact optimum in the enlarged power-weight forest class, or a precise counterexample if the tail/forest argument fails. No new kappa.
coordination: No pinned sprint issue; only open non-PR issues 650 and 913. Local claim used after queue refresh through954.
result: Every nonunit signed power-of-two parent edge on historical CK costs at least 10 additional primitives per component versus making its child a root. Edge deletion handles overlapping forests, yielding cost >= 16,364 + 10*m with m nonunit edges. The original PR816 unit forest attains the all-power class floor 16,364; no new circuit saving or kappa.
validation: Two exact implementations agree on 174,048 finite cases; written tail proof covers all integer exponents. All 12,544 unit-cycle inequalities, independent Prim floor, 716-column panel replays in both orientations, 1,058 literal coefficient cases / 72,632 primitive instructions, nine primary controls, two coefficient controls and seven package tests pass. Both full receipts match in a minimal read-only optimized CPython 3.12.3 environment and CPython 3.14.4.
